'''DecipherCon 1999 Japanese Sealed Deck''' was a Star Wars CCG side event at [[DecipherCon 1999]] (11–14 November 1999, Cavalier Hotel, Virginia Beach, Virginia). [[Martin Falke]] won the Friday heat, out of 149 players over 4 games.<ref name="dc99sw23_1">[http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/scores/SW23_1.html DecipherCon 1999 – Event Scores: Japanese Sealed Deck], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010108184600/http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/scores/SW23_1.html Internet Archive]</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Type:''' Side event (Japanese Sealed Deck)
* '''Format:''' [[Japanese Sealed Deck]]<ref name="dc99-fri">[http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/fri_events.html DecipherCon 1999 – Event Schedule: Friday], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20000708001407/http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/fri_events.html Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="dc99-sun">[http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/sun_events.html DecipherCon 1999 – Event Schedule: Sunday], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20001026063736/http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/sun_events.html Internet Archive]</ref>
* '''Date:''' Friday 12 November 1999, 8 p.m.–2 a.m.; Sunday 14 November 1999, 11 a.m.–5 p.m.
* '''Site:''' Cavalier Hotel, Virginia Beach, Virginia
* '''Players:''' 149 (Friday heat)

Decipher scheduled a second heat on Sunday. A Sunday score sheet is not preserved.<ref name="dc99-sun">[http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/sun_events.html DecipherCon 1999 – Event Schedule: Sunday], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20001026063736/http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/sun_events.html Internet Archive]</ref>
